12.7 shelf to S102 center face
Gold: drawing-derived TFF400 envelope. Pale blue: custom CNC adapter candidates. Sky blue: exact ROBOTIS solids.
The fixed-adapter support pattern, connector orientation, fillets, tooling access, material allowables and proof remain OPEN.
Controlled candidate features
TFF flange: 100 × 100 × 13.0 mm
TFF clearance: 4 × Ø4.50 ±0.05 on BCD31.75 basic
Pattern position: Ø0.10 to pilot datum axis
Mating-face flatness: 0.05 / 50 mm candidate
Candidate finish: Ra 1.6 µm; deburr 0.2–0.5 mm
Active shelf: 52.4 × 50.0 × 12.7 mm
Candidate screws: M2.5×12 low head; NOT SELECTED
Nominal screw-head/X430 gap: 1.900 mm
Required before quote/fabrication:
manufacturer CAD and application confirmation
GD&T/threads/fillets/access reviewed by qualified engineer
FEA, fatigue, fastener, deflection and proof definition
received-part CMM/fit evidence and controlled first article
DO NOT FABRICATE FROM THIS DRAWING.
Dimensions define a review candidate and vendor questions; they are not production authority.
All tolerances are provisional until the sensor manufacturer, machinist and qualified mechanical reviewer accept the stack.
